# Eduport Design System

> Design tokens, Lit web components (`<ep-*>`) and React wrappers for Eduport apps. Packages: @eduportdesign/tokens, @eduportdesign/web-components, @eduportdesign/react. Light/dark themes via `data-theme`, soft/sharp corners via `data-corners`, reduced motion via `data-motion`. Style custom UI only with semantic `--ep-*` tokens; WCAG 2.1 AA is required.

Start with the AI guide. It has setup (including the base stylesheet and a page skeleton every screen should start from), every component's tag, props, slots and events, the token list, accessibility rules and do/don't examples in one file.

## Docs

- [AI coding assistant guide](docs/llm-guide.md): the full reference for generating UI with this design system
- [Spacing and layout](docs/layout.md): read before building an app shell or a page. Page structure (top bar, side nav, page header, sections), space scale, layout grid, breakpoints and content widths
- [README](README.md): overview, install from npm or GitHub Packages, development and release
- [Web components](packages/web-components/README.md): component table and conventions
- Custom Elements Manifest: `node_modules/@eduportdesign/web-components/dist/custom-elements.json` in an installed app. Machine-readable list of every tag's attributes, properties, slots, CSS parts and events
- [React](packages/react/README.md): wrapper names, props and event props
- [Component gallery](https://ritwik-sb.github.io/Eduport-Design/): every component, live, with theme and corner switches
- [Storybook](https://ritwik-sb.github.io/Eduport-Design/storybook/): per-component controls and stories
- [Tokens](packages/tokens/README.md): CSS, SCSS and JS outputs, theme files
- [Logos](packages/logos/README.md): every logo file, which one to use where, clear space, minimum size and theme switching

## Optional

- [Interaction and motion](docs/motion.md): states, keyboard, feedback timing, motion tokens, reduced motion and the allowed microinteractions
- [Foundations](docs/foundations.md): how the color scales, type, radius and icon choices were made, with contrast results
- [Token sources](packages/tokens/src): DTCG JSON for primitives, themes and corner modes
- [Component sources](packages/web-components/src/components): Lit source with JSDoc `@slot`, `@csspart` and `@fires` tags
